description: Add a domain to a Ulinkly project. Two kinds are supported: (1) shared domains, a free *.shared.ly subdomain (e.g. myapp.shared.ly; pass the full host), which work immediately; and (2) custom domains you own (e.g. links.example.com), which require a paid plan. A custom domain only works after you add the DNS records listed in this tool's response (also shown in the Ulinkly dashboard under Domains) at your DNS provider and then call verify_domain. If `type` is omitted it is inferred from the host: *.shared.ly is shared, anything else is custom.

host.description: The full domain hostname, e.g. links.example.com (custom) or myapp.shared.ly (shared)

projectId.description: The project to add the domain to

type.description: Domain type. Optional: inferred from the host when omitted (*.shared.ly is 'shared', otherwise 'custom').

name: add_domain
title: Add Domain
